summary: Comprehensive testing of SMC (Smart Money Concepts) features for the Bybit trading bot. Verified FVG/OB detection, structural SL/TP placement, zone proximity methods, confluence detection, SMC-based entry signals, exit engine trailing, and 15-minute basket profit guard timer. All 41 new tests pass. 53 older tests fail because the entry engine was refactored from breakout/pullback detection to SMC-based scoring - these tests check for OLD methods/logic that no longer exist.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The entry engine was completely refactored to use SMC (Smart Money Concepts) based scoring instead of breakout/pullback detection. Key features: (1) StructureZoneAnalyzer detects FVG and Order Blocks from HTF klines, (2) ZoneContext provides structural SL/TP and zone proximity checks, (3) EntryEngine._smc_long_score/_smc_short_score compute scores based on price proximity to zones, (4) Transformer/orderflow are soft boosters not hard gates, (5) 15-minute basket profit guard timer via BasketProfitState.drawdown_detected_at. Old tests in test_generic_market_quality.py, test_entry_engine_and_level_derivation.py, etc. should be removed or updated as they test deprecated logic.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - This is a verification test run, not bug investigation. The 53 failing tests are from previous iterations that tested OLD entry logic (breakout/pullback/continuation detection) which has been replaced by SMC-based entry (FVG + Order Block zones).
